# SliderLib

`SliderLib` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `field:onFocus()`.

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`onFocus()`](onFocus.md) | Function called when the focus is changed. | 1.6.2 |
| [`step()`](step.md) | Get / Set the field step. | 1.6.2 |
| [`minimum()`](minimum.md) | Set the field minimum value. | 1.6.2 |
| [`maximum()`](maximum.md) | Set the field maximum value. | 1.6.2 |
| [`help()`](help.md) | Set the field help text. | 1.6.2 |
